features.description: Day-0 safety guard: backend rejects a second POST that would overwrite an existing (teacher,class,conceptSkillId) activity config unless activity_id is explicitly the same. Stops silent data loss immediately, independent of the rest of M0.
acceptance_criteria: A second POST /api/activity-configs that would overwrite an existing concept config for the same (teacher,class) is rejected with a clear error (409/400), not silently set()
An explicit same-activity_id re-save (legitimate edit) still succeeds
Regression test covers both paths; make test-fast green
features.notes: Shipped. createOnly flag on POST; backend 409 if doc exists; ConflictError surfaces honest message on create page. 31 backend + 23 frontend tests green. Edit path (no flag) keeps idempotent upsert.

Dual-read fallback in resolution (new activity id, else legacy composite key). Dry-run mode + migration notes file.

Dual-read: a mid-session legacy skill-id still resolves a config during cutover
Backfill is additive (never deletes activity_configs); dry-run mode works; side effects recorded in a migration-notes file
Tests: backfill idempotency, bare-lesson wrap, dual-read fallback; make test-fast green
